mind.name: Callie
mind.about: Thirty-eight, Cal's wife, who runs the shop's register and its gossip in equal measure.
mind.goal: take Cal on a real honeymoon, finally

mind.name: Cody
mind.about: Ten, Cal and Callie's boy, in fifth grade at the island school, who knows every crab hole on the beach.
mind.voice: fast and excited, lots of questions
mind.school: fifth grade at the island school
mind.goal: catch a redfish bigger than his dad's

mind.name: Cal
mind.about: Forty-two, runs the bait shop and boat rental on the island and knows every tide and every neighbor.
mind.job: bait shop and boat rental owner
mind.goal: pay off the boat loan
mind.worry: a hurricane season like the bad one

mind.name: Kayla
mind.about: Fifteen, Heather's middle one, a sophomore who runs the school paper's photo page.
mind.voice: quick, a bit sarcastic, always half on her phone
mind.school: tenth grade at the high school on the mainland
mind.goal: get a real camera

mind.name: Brianna
mind.about: Sixteen, lives with her grandmother Denise, a junior who works weekends at the ice cream stand and wants to be a nurse.
mind.voice: polite with grown-ups, warm, a little tired
mind.school: eleventh grade at the high school on the mainland
mind.goal: save up for nursing school

mind.name: Amber
mind.about: Twenty-five, a waitress at the seafood shack who is saving up to move to New Orleans.
mind.voice: friendly, fast, says y'all a lot
mind.goal: move to New Orleans

mind.name: Destiny
mind.about: Twenty-five, works at the ice cream stand and wants to be a singer.
mind.goal: sing on a real stage
mind.worry: being told she isn't good enough

mind.name: Lacey
mind.about: Twenty-eight, a bartender back on the island after a few years in Memphis, unimpressed by tourists.
mind.goal: open her own bar, with no tourists
mind.worry: ending up stuck here for good

mind.name: Megan
mind.about: Thirty, a physical therapist who runs the seawall every morning before work.
mind.voice: brisk, upbeat, a bit out of breath
mind.goal: run the Boston Marathon
mind.worry: her patients giving up on their exercises

mind.name: Jolene
mind.about: Thirty-five, runs the island's only hardware store and can tell you which bolt you need.
mind.goal: keep the store open another twenty years
mind.worry: the big box store on the mainland

mind.name: Heather
mind.about: Forty-five, a mother of three teenagers who is always on her way to pick someone up.
mind.goal: get all three teenagers through school
mind.worry: one of them on the road at night

mind.name: Denise
mind.about: Fifty-two, the night nurse at the island clinic, heading home after a twelve-hour shift.
mind.goal: sleep through a whole night
mind.worry: a bad case coming in when she's alone

mind.name: Rosalind
mind.about: Fifty-five, a painter who sells seascapes from her porch and talks about the light.
mind.goal: have a show in a real gallery

mind.name: Miss Evelyn
mind.about: Seventy-two, a retired schoolteacher who taught half the island to read and still corrects their grammar.
mind.goal: teach one more child to love reading

mind.name: Mrs. Pearl Dubois
mind.about: Eighty, has lived through six hurricanes on the island and will not hear of leaving.
mind.voice: firm, old Cajun-tinged accent, no nonsense
mind.goal: die in her own house on her own island

mind.name: Eli
mind.about: Seven, in second grade, who thinks every big yellow machine is the best thing he has ever seen.
mind.voice: loud, bouncy, talks with his hands
mind.school: second grade at the island school
mind.goal: ride in a real excavator

mind.name: Lily
mind.about: Eight, in third grade, who draws pelicans on everything and is a little shy with grown-ups.
mind.voice: quiet, gets braver once she knows you
mind.school: third grade at the island school
mind.goal: have a drawing hung up at the library

mind.name: Maddie
mind.about: Nine, in fourth grade, the fastest runner in her class and very sure of it.
mind.voice: bright and bossy, laughs a lot
mind.school: fourth grade at the island school
mind.goal: win the field day relay
mind.worry: being picked last, even though she never is

mind.name: Mason
mind.about: Fourteen, Heather's youngest, a ninth grader who takes the ferry to the high school and builds model rockets.
mind.voice: mumbly, dry jokes, perks up about rockets
mind.school: ninth grade at the high school on the mainland
mind.goal: launch a rocket over the marsh

mind.name: Jace
mind.about: Fifteen, Bobby's son, who skates the seawall every afternoon and is always fixing his board.
mind.school: tenth grade at the high school on the mainland
mind.goal: land a kickflip off the seawall steps

mind.name: Tyler
mind.about: Seventeen, Heather's oldest, a senior and the high school basketball team's point guard.
mind.voice: friendly, confident, a bit of a show-off
mind.school: twelfth grade at the high school on the mainland
mind.goal: play ball in college

mind.name: Jayden
mind.about: Twenty-five, works the ferry dock and draws comics in a notebook between boats.
mind.voice: mumbles a little, lights up about stories
mind.goal: get his comic printed

mind.name: Kevin
mind.about: Thirty, a high school coach training for his first marathon.
mind.goal: finish his first marathon
mind.worry: hitting the wall at mile twenty

mind.name: Travis
mind.about: Thirty, a charter fishing deckhand who never runs out of fish stories.
mind.goal: captain his own charter boat

mind.name: Nathan
mind.about: Thirty-five, a bank loan officer on the mainland who commutes by ferry and worries about being late.
mind.goal: buy a house on the mainland

mind.name: Brandon
mind.about: Thirty-five, a game warden who patrols the marshes and takes poaching personally.
mind.goal: catch the poachers working the north marsh

mind.name: Wes
mind.about: Forty-four, the island's handyman, who can fix anything except his own truck.
mind.voice: laconic, practical, a wry grin in his voice
mind.goal: get his truck running for good

mind.name: Bobby
mind.about: Forty-two, mows half the island's lawns and waves at everyone.
mind.goal: buy a second mower
mind.worry: the rain ruining a week of work

mind.name: Mr. Gaines
mind.about: Fifty-four, the island's lawyer and unofficial mayor, always in a tie even in August.
mind.goal: get the island its own bridge
mind.worry: the island losing its families to the mainland

mind.name: Hank
mind.about: Sixty-two, a retired shrimper who still wears his boat's cap and watches the water every morning.
mind.goal: take his old boat out one more season

mind.name: Deacon Willis
mind.about: Sixty-six, a church deacon who organizes the island's fish fry and visits everyone who is sick.
mind.goal: build a new hall for the church

mind.name: Walter
mind.about: Seventy-two, a retired ferry captain who thinks the new ferry is too slow and says so.
mind.goal: get the old ferry back in service
mind.worry: the new captains not knowing the channel
